title: Decision correlates beyond movement
scientific_question: Within the fixed first100ms stimulus window, does neural activity improve prediction of final right/NoGo/left choice beyond a competent common stimulus/history/wheel predictor, and how do equally sampled co-recorded regional populations differ?
primary_outputs: Recorded final response on every required query trial, with source -1,0,+1 mapped to right,NoGo,left probabilities. Region-wise predictive effects are recomputed from paired losses rather than scored against a preferred biological conclusion.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: First100ms spikes from source-QC2/3 units, including silent units; no activity-dependent unit selection.
Common current stimulus, previous source stimulus, chronological clock and fixed wheel observations; current stimulus is allowed because the target is final choice.
Regional subsets use K=min(n_left,n_right), outcome/activity-independent nested hash ranks and fresh dense unit aliases.
forbidden_inputs: Final choice labels, private SESSION mappings and future response observations outside the fixed window
Literal anatomy, source identities and source-unit mappings in candidate context when the declared blind regional protocol is used
Private targets or reference fitted states as investigator tools
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Source requires39 sessions,10 mice and opaque query tokens in authenticated roster. Whole keys are w-{ordinal:02d}-{context|joint}; regional keys bind pair0..2627, session ordinal1..39, one of seeds2026110700..2026110704 and left/right. Actual source token map remains operator-side.
allowed_inputs.split: Declared6014 fit,1994 validation and2042 query rows across39 sessions, partitioned chronologically before eligibility filtering; per-session fitting with training/validation refit. These are source-declared counts, not data reauthenticated in this revision.
allowed_inputs.coverage: All73 literal unmerged labels and2628 unordered pairs are represented; structural unsupported pair/session cells remain explicit. All original39 sessions and10 mouse positions remain in reporting. Conditions and seeds add no task IDs.

biological_unit: Mouse with sessions nested; co-recorded unit subsets and five seeds are repeated technical conditions, not biological replicates.

primary.name: competent nuisance-reference log loss minus candidate whole-joint log loss
primary.aggregation: Per-trial paired difference, average within session, equal sessions within mouse, then equal weight over all10 mice.
primary.rationale: The source fixes an independently selected competent stimulus/history/wheel reference so deliberately weakening candidate nuisance fitting cannot inflate the primary neural contribution.

secondary: All-arm natural-log loss, sum-of-three Brier score and top1 accuracy.
Regional side gain over common nuisance and competent regional references; descriptive right-minus-left paired loss.
Regional hierarchy: trials then five seed results, supported sessions within mouse, supported mice; never average seed probabilities.
Matched investigator-minus-frozen contrasts and context-by-neural interaction are diagnostics, not replacements for the competent-reference primary.

comparators.procedure: Implemented source selection menu uses prior/logistic/HGB, validation selection and fresh fit+validation refit; reference fitting/custody must be executed and independently qualified.

comparators.procedure: Implemented source uses four-C joint-logistic selection and final refit; three sealed common nuisance states are reused, one regional joint fit is new.

comparators.procedure: Analytic1/3 probabilities retained as a diagnostic; cannot substitute for competent nuisance control.

evaluation.uncertainty: Current source reports descriptive finite-cohort effects, explicit coverage and seed variability; it defines no bootstrap, p-value or population-valid regional interval. Any new inferential comparison must prespecify mouse-level dependence and multiplicity across2628 pairs before outcomes.
evaluation.failure_policy: Authenticate every candidate/reference probability table and complete producer closure before first protected choice read. Missing late outputs block whole grading. Zero true-class probability is infinite loss; inf-inf and mixed signed infinities remain undefined; no dropping or clipping.
